title: Harden canonical reader browser parity and rapid-scroll runtime

sourceRefs.summary: Approved 20-slice Safari/WebKit and rapid-scroll hardening detour with exact predecessor restoration boundary.

verificationRecords.scope: Slice 1 control-plane status derives the new 20-slice hardening contract while the predecessor remains stored at slice 14.
Slice 1 separate hardening contract, active priority checkpoint, source-linked target done contract, and stored predecessor are graph-valid.

Slice 2 Playwright WebKit 26.5 canonical fraction-reader smoke: measured cancellation motif, wide and phone paint, direct seek, rewind, exclusive authority, endpoints, fit evidence, and review launcher passed.
verificationRecords.notes: The run also exposed existing asynchronous phone-stage readable-floor diagnostics, retained for baseline classification in slices 3-5; they did not fail the canonical motif contract.

verificationRecords.scope: Slice 2 Playwright WebKit project and scoped browser-contract scripts typecheck across application, Node, test, and domain projects.

verificationRecords.notes: Typed runtime metrics and browser harness compile across app, node, tests, and domains.

30-frame bidirectional trace passed; baseline identified 28 canonical session builds, 6758.8 ms aggregate build time, 13 frames over 50 ms, approximately 533 ms p95, zero scroll-geometry recompiles, and zero material-owner add/remove churn.

verificationRecords.scope: slice 04 deterministic Chromium baseline, repeated twice
verificationRecords.notes: Both repetitions produced the frozen 30-frame work counters: 0 scroll-geometry reads, 30 anchor reads, 28 session builds, 2 reuses, 30 applies, and 0 material-owner additions or removals. Frame timing remains attached evidence rather than an environment-dependent baseline allowance.

expectedLearning: Whether one measured-paint browser contract and a pure-plan cache can make canonical equation scrolling responsive without weakening collision certification or multiplying visual runtimes.
allowedWork: Canonical fraction-reader browser verification, scheduler hot path, semantic state diffing, material-owner diffing, pure compositor-plan caching, bounded idle prewarming, and atomic latest-only handoff.
disallowedWork: No semantic or motif changes, no second renderer or scheduler, no mounted-resource cache, no family-wide rollout, and no browser-specific geometry exception.
